verdict.rationale: Twenty exposes an MCP server and full REST/GraphQL API (twenty-docs-32, twenty-docs-8) that give agents programmatic access to CRM records, and emails/calendar events are automatically linked to Company/People records (twenty-docs-4, twenty-docs-52, twenty-docs-58), while deals/opportunities are standard CRM objects (twenty-docs-14) — together this is exactly the data (open deals, emails, history) an agent would query via API/MCP to compile a brief. The built-in AI chatbot can also query and summarize CRM data in natural language (twenty-docs-18, twenty-docs-69) and agents can be scoped with role permissions (twenty-docs-71). Missing for 10: a documented end-to-end tutorial/example specifically producing an 'account brief' before a meeting, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
